vehicle.title: Honda Civic Type R
vehicle.subtitle: 2025 Honda Civic Type R (FL5)
vehicle.sourceLabel: Reference photographs by Bruno Silie / Maison Throne

views.label: Square front (straight-on)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The photographed hood rests on its safety catch. The matching 3D view uses the same slightly raised position. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 92.6%.

views.label: Front-right three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The hood, bumper brow and fender crowns meet along the painted panel edges. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 91.0%.

views.label: Side profile (right)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The reference hood is on its safety catch. The wheel centers and roofline provide a scale reference in this profile. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 83.1%.

views.label: Rear-right three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The bumper wraps below the outer lamps and meets the diffuser around the three exhaust tips. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 89.7%.

views.label: Square rear (straight-on)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The center exhaust outlet is larger than the two outer outlets. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 90.3%.

views.label: Rear-left three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The matching view includes the slightly raised hood seen on the reference car. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 86.3%.

views.label: Side profile (left)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The reference hood is on its safety catch. This profile shows the door cutlines above the rear wheel arch. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 85.8%.

views.label: Front-left three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The reference hood is on its safety catch. Reset the 3D viewer to inspect the closed hood. The estimated silhouettes overlap by 88.0%.

views.label: Low square front
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The low viewpoint exposes the depth of the lower grille and the intercooler fins behind it.

views.label: High front nose & hood plan
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: With the hood closed, its leading edge sits about 6 mm behind the nose. The side clearance is about 4.4–4.9 mm on the model.

views.label: High rear-right three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The wing and its two supports move with the hatch.

views.label: High square rear
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The straight edge across the top of the rear glass follows the curved roof header.

views.label: High roof & windshield crown (front-left)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The roof crown and windshield meet at the same curved header.

views.label: High rear roof & shark-fin antenna (rear-right)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The fixed rear quarter panels surround the side glass. The sloped rear glass belongs to the hatch.

views.label: Test view: close square front (hood latched)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The upper grille and headlight housings share a continuous opening. The lower intake has a recessed hexagonal mesh.

views.label: Test view: mid rear-right three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The red lamp bar splits at the hatch opening.

views.label: Test view: high rear-left three-quarter
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The paint and studio reflections differ between the two views. The window edges and wing supports are useful alignment points.

views.label: Front-left corner, illuminated DRL & Type R badge
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The upper daytime running light turns down beside the three reflector cups.

views.label: Right LED headlamp & amber side marker
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The amber side marker sits inside the wrapped end of the lens. The internal optics are simplified.

views.label: Left LED taillamp (lit) & CIVIC badge
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The fixed outer lamp meets the section on the moving hatch. The lens texture is approximate.

views.label: Right LED taillamp (lit) & Type R badge
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The upper light bar and outer reflector follow the hatch seam. Lens fluting and badge lettering are simplified.

views.label: Gloss-black rear wing & die-cast aluminum stays
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The two uprights support a curved airfoil with downturned ends.

views.label: Right gloss-black power side mirror
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The housing attaches to the door. The studio reflection differs from the outdoor photograph.

views.label: Left widebody front fender & functional side vent
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The outlet sits behind the front wheel and ahead of the front door.

views.label: Center-mounted triple-outlet exhaust & diffuser
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The three outlets sit inside the diffuser recess. The heat shields and pipe joints are simplified.

views.label: Front-left 19" Y-spoke wheel, Michelin PS4S & Brembo brake
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The front wheel has five split spokes and a red caliper. Tire sidewall lettering and fine casting marks are omitted.

views.label: Rear-left 19" wheel, solid rotor & red rear caliper
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The rear wheel uses the same spoke pattern around a smaller brake disc.

views.label: Open rear hatch (rear-right three-quarter)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: Opening the hatch lifts the glass, wing and inner lamps together. Cargo trim is approximate.

views.label: Open rear hatch (square rear)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The upright rear seats and cargo sill are visible through the open hatch.

views.label: Open hood & K20C1 engine bay (front-left 3/4)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The engine cover, intake and battery locate the major assemblies. Hoses, wiring and fasteners are schematic.

views.label: Open hood & K20C1 engine bay (square front)
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The hood opens at the cowl. The engine bay shows the major components in simplified form.

views.label: Cabin & dashboard overview
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The model shows the driver controls and console layout. Switchgear, trim and displays are simplified.

views.label: Front-right red suede-effect sport bucket seat
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The isolated seats and center console show their relative placement. Bolsters and upholstery are approximate.

views.label: Steering wheel & 10.2" digital instrument cluster
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: Steering-wheel controls and the instrument display are schematic.

views.label: Honeycomb dashboard vent mesh & plaque R-41430
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The passenger-side plaque identifies the photographed car. The dashboard vent and lettering are simplified.

views.label: Center console, aluminum teardrop shift knob & +R toggle
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The manual shifter, cupholders and console switches are modeled as separate shapes.

views.label: Rear-right open door card & suede trim
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The inside of the opened rear door shows the handle, armrest and lower pocket in simplified form.

views.label: Rear two-passenger black cloth bench & red seatbelts
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The model isolates the rear seats. Seat padding, stitching and side trim are approximate.

views.label: Front underside & aero undertray
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: This view looks beneath the splitter toward the front wheels. The undertray, ribs and fasteners are schematic.

views.label: Rear underside, triple-outlet muffler & diffuser
views.credit: Bruno Silie / Maison Throne via Bring a Trailer (Lot #231,834, seller Hobie109)
views.note: The exhaust outlet sizes and the path of the center pipe are visible. Heat shielding and suspension detail are approximate.
